title.vi: Làm thủ tục tại sân bay

npcLines: Good morning. May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
Hello. Could I have your passport and booking reference?
turns.translation: Chào buổi sáng. Cho tôi xem hộ chiếu và mã đặt chỗ của bạn được không?
accepted: Here is my passport and my booking reference
Here you are. This is my passport and booking reference
Certainly, here is my passport and booking reference
Sure, here are my passport and booking reference
turns.hint: Try: Here is my passport and my booking reference.

npcLines: Thank you. Are you checking in any luggage today?
Do you have any bags to check in?
turns.translation: Cảm ơn bạn. Hôm nay bạn có ký gửi hành lý không?
accepted: I would like to check in one suitcase
I'd like to check in one suitcase
I have one suitcase to check in
turns.hint: Try: I would like to check in one suitcase.

npcLines: Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
Do you prefer the window or the aisle?
turns.translation: Bạn thích ghế cạnh cửa sổ hay lối đi?
accepted: I would prefer a window seat, if possible
I'd prefer a window seat if possible
I would like an aisle seat, please
turns.hint: Try: I would prefer a window seat, if possible.

npcLines: Here is your boarding pass. Boarding starts at gate twelve in forty minutes.
Your gate is twelve, and boarding begins in forty minutes.
turns.translation: Đây là thẻ lên máy bay của bạn. Việc lên máy bay bắt đầu ở cổng mười hai sau bốn mươi phút.
accepted: Thank you. Is the flight on time
Thank you very much. Is the flight on schedule
turns.hint: Try: Thank you. Is the flight on time?
